claim_text: Folk name 'Throw Barbarian'; aliases 'Throwing Barb', 'Double Throw Barbarian'
anchor_quote: The Throw Barbarian is a heavily gear dependent character that takes advantage of the Double Throw and Throwing Mastery skills.

claim_text: Folk name 'Trapsin'; aliases 'Lightning Sentry Assassin', 'Trap Assassin', 'Death Sentry Trapsin'
anchor_quote: The Lightning Sentry / Death Sentry Assassin, aka Trapsin is THE staple build for starting an Assassin.

claim_text: Core skills: Lightning Sentry, Death Sentry, Shadow Master
anchor_quote: Lightning Sentry shoots a piercing Lightning Bolt in the direction of its closest target. Shadow Master randomly uses Skills from the Assassin's Skill Tree.
Traps are considered minions; -% to Lightning Resistance attributes do NOT apply to them in Lord of Destruction but DO apply in Diablo 2 Resurrected thanks to recent Patches.

claim_text: Folk name 'Wind Druid'; aliases 'Tornado Hurricane Druid', 'Elemental Druid'
anchor_quote: The Tornado Hurricane Druid or 'Wind Druid' is one of the most versatile Magic Finding builds.

claim_text: Core skills: Tornado, Hurricane, Cyclone Armor, Oak Sage
anchor_quote: 20 points to Tornado — main damage dealer, required. 20 points to Hurricane — main crowd control and cold damage dealer, required. 20 points to Cyclone Armor — great elemental absorb, required. 1-20 points to Oak Sage — bonus to Life for you and party, required.
Tornados move in semi-random winding paths in the direction you cast them.

claim_text: Folk name 'Abyss Warlock'; aliases 'Abyss Warlock D2R', 'Warlock Abyss School'
anchor_quote: The Abyss Warlock Endgame Guide melts through enemies with AoE Magic Damage!

claim_text: Core skills: (abyss school) — Abyss-tree magic AoE skills
anchor_quote: Abyss pulls targets in and deals AoE damage over time before detonating. Miasma Chains and Miasma Bolt as core damage skills.
The Abyss Warlock is what you should use if you want to farm Terror Zones, with its strong AoE damage and added utility.

claim_text: Folk name 'Blood Boil Warlock'; aliases 'Blood Boil Warlock D2R', 'Tainted Summon Blood Boil'
anchor_quote: Blood Boil Warlock and Summon Tainted are the primary designations used throughout this Season 14 guide.

claim_text: Core skills: Blood Boil, Summon Tainted
anchor_quote: Blood Boil causes a % Loss of Maximum Life to all of your summoned and bound demons dealing damage evenly split between Fire and Physical Damage in up to 7 Yards.

claim_text: Folk name 'Echoing Strike Warlock'; aliases 'Echoing Strike Warlock D2R'
anchor_quote: Echoing Strike Warlock Endgame Build Guide for Diablo II: Resurrected Season 14
The Echoing Strike Warlock throws projections of his weapons in front of himself, dealing damage both on the way out and the way in.
In Season 13, Echoing Strike was stacking damage multiplicatively instead of additively — which was a bug, not a feature.

claim_text: Folk name 'Fire Warlock'; aliases 'Fire Warlock D2R', 'Warlock Fire School'
anchor_quote: The Fire Warlock is a Ranged Caster that takes advantage of three very powerful Fire skills.

claim_text: Core skills: (fire school) — Ring of Fire, Flame Wave, Apocalypse in Chaos tree
anchor_quote: Ring of Fire, Flame Wave, and Apocalypse all have large Area of Effect Fire Damage making the Chaos tree one of the best leveling trees.
Fire Warlock is exceptionally good as a ladder starter because it can get going with just minimal investment.

claim_text: Folk name 'Tainted Summoner Warlock'; aliases 'Tainted Summoner Warlock D2R', 'Bind Demon Warlock'
Core skills: Bind Demon, Summon Tainted
anchor_quote: Bind Demon is crucial, as it allows you to convert a Unique monster to your side. Blood Boil causes % Loss of Maximum Life to all summoned and bound demons.
Summon Tainted deals considerable AoE Fire Damage with its primary ranged attack. This quickly kills any enemies who are not naturally Fire Resistant.
